objects.name: request_message
objects.interpretation: 6-word writable Mach message template1,24,0,0,0,0x232324; last word is message ID scalar, not pointer. Controller submit/interrupt paths copy and populate ports.

objects.name: OSMRoutines
objects.interpretation: 124-byte writable OSM dispatch: version scalar0 plus30 callbacks. Exact three erased-formal slots21/23/24 preserve reviewed machine contracts; existing draft definition requires Task14 typed replacement.

objects.name: adapterQ
objects.interpretation: 512 writable zero bytes =64 native8-byte queue heads, initial sentinel links zero until module/controller initialization. Existing256-entry draft/constructor is pending Task14 repair.

objects.name: diagnostic_strings

objects.name: SCSIHostType
objects.interpretation: 40 pairs of host product/vendor ID and match mask; entries0..38 supported, entry39 zero sentinel. GetNextHostDeviceType accepts unsigned index<=39, returns busType0 and mask only for nonzero ID. ID/masks are raw PCI encoding scalars.

objects.name: SCSISubSystemSubVendorType
objects.interpretation: 16 pairs of subsystem/subvendor ID and full32-bit match mask. Enumerator accepts unsigned index<=13; entries14/15 (0x38689004/0x38699004) are preserved unreachable tail records, not sentinels.

objects.name: SCSIFuncPtrs
objects.interpretation: Version word4 followed by41 typed public HIM callbacks in metadata order. Eight erased-formal callbacks retain the approved unspecified-argument machine contracts.

objects.name: SCSIConfiguration
objects.interpretation: 17 exact native configuration scalars, version4, maxInternalIOBlocks255,maxTargets16,unbounded SG/transfer0xffffffff,initiator1,target0,IOB reserve88,state3304,maxIOHandles2,32-bit bus address allocation. No pointer fields.

objects.name: SCSIDefaultAdapterProfile
objects.interpretation: 464-byte version7 adapter profile. Encoded native member types/signedness,32 zero WWID bytes, five zero target-task-management flags and55-word transport union; exact default scalar values, zero/reserved words and0xffffffff limits preserved.

objects.name: SCSIAdjustableAdapterProfile
objects.interpretation: 464-byte adapter adjustability mask, fields0/1 are permission scalars, not pointers/boolean callbacks; full union55 words retained, including per-target masks and reserved zeros.

objects.name: SCSIDefaultTargetProfile
objects.interpretation: 124-byte31-word target profile, version5, transport1, default queue/speed/width/offset/option scalars; words are native32-bit scalar positions consumed by ProfileTarget/AdjustTargetProfile. No pointer fields.

objects.name: SCSIAdjustableTargetProfile
objects.interpretation: 124-byte31-word target adjustability mask, leading scalar2, remaining permission/zero words retained. No pointer fields.

objects.name: SCSIscontrol
objects.interpretation: 8 task-attribute indexed SCB control bytes:0x60,0x62,0x61,0,0,0,0,0. Standard/swapping32 builders OR0x40 for allowed tagging; advanced builders use raw values. Tail zero entries retained.

objects.name: event_names
objects.interpretation: 8 native value/name-pointer pairs for IOFindNameForValue, event values4,5,1,2,3,6,7 and terminating0/null. All seven pointers name diagnostic literals; pending Task14 OSMEvent definition and coupled body recovery.
